name: Blackfathom Deeps
summary: Naga, satyr, and the Twilight's Hammer hold Blackfathom Deeps beneath Ashenvale's northwestern coast. Flooded halls that once honored Elune lie in ruin beneath the Zoram Strand.

sections.title: From Elune's Temple to Darkest Abyss
sections.body: Beneath Ashenvale's northwestern cliffs, flooded halls remain from an ancient temple. Before the Great Sundering shattered Kalimdor ten thousand years ago, the temple honored Elune and held its own moonwell. When the Well of Eternity collapsed, the shrine sank beneath the waves and was thought lost forever. Over millennia, the shorelines receded and the ground shifted, leaving the temple partly flooded beneath the cliffs.

sections.title: Aku'mai and the Cult
sections.body: The Twilight's Hammer has made its home in the flooded temple under Twilight Lord Kelris. Corruption from an Old God has risen through the deep earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well. From its waters rose Aku'mai, a monstrous three-headed hydra and servant of the Old God. Naga led by Lady Sarevess and prowling satyrs join the cultists, who sacrifice innocents to Aku'mai for power.

faq.q: What was Blackfathom Deeps originally built for?
faq.answer: Before it sank beneath the waves in the Sundering, Blackfathom Deeps was a night elven temple to Elune, with a sacred moonwell at its heart.

faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer cult here?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer came to worship Aku'mai, a primeval hydra and servant of an Old God. Under Twilight Lord Kelris, the cult sacrifices innocents to the beast for dark power.
The entrance lies among cavernous ruins along the Zoram Strand, on Ashenvale's far northwestern coast. You pass through submerged chambers and hostile naga outposts to reach the temple portal.
Ghamoo-ra is a giant, maddened turtle lurking on an island in one of the temple's flooded caverns. It attacks any intruder who comes near.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei, you may mourn this ancient shrine to Elune. Void cultists and naga have defiled its sacred halls and moonwell.
As a member of the Horde, you know the deeps lie uncomfortably close to Zoram'gar. The cultists and naga gathering on the Zoram Strand threaten the outpost's defenders.
